title.narrative: Cambodia University of Management and Technology Debt Repayment

description.narrative: - Raising the quality of higher education. - Contributing to awareness and integrating graduates into their communities. - Raising the standard of living of graduates and enabling them to hold important jobs in the country.

Due to the need of the Cambodian University of Management and Technology to pay the financial dues for its founding period to cover the university’s operating budget related to the cost of renting the university building, the costs of furniture, office supplies, urgent equipment and facilities and other technical matters, in addition to paying the salaries of administrative and academic staff, Saleh Abdulaziz Al Rajhi Endowments provided generous support to cover the estimated cost of (897,995) US dollars, with the debt to be paid through the International University of Madinah in Malaysia.

This contribution aims to support higher education in Cambodia by establishing a university according to international standards, to graduate a qualified emerging generation, who are able to contribute positively to society.
